name: Legal Review
description: Performs a legal review on a document, proposes redline modifications with reasoning, and generates a structured summary document.

document_id.description: The Google Doc ID to review

steps.title: Analyze Document
steps.description: Access the target document ${document_id} and analyze its contents for legal risks, structural concerns, clarity, and opportunities for redline improvements.
steps.accept_criteria: The document ${document_id} was successfully retrieved and analyzed for risks, concerns, and proposed redlines.

steps.title: Propose Edits & Explanations
steps.description: Draft and apply proposed changes to the document for review, including the legal reasoning or explanation for each suggested modification, using the document suggestion capability.
steps.accept_criteria: Suggested changes and reasons are prepared and presented in the document according to the suggestion workflow.

steps.title: Notify Reviewer
steps.description: Leave a notification comment on the document directing the reviewer to the proposed edits, and wait for their response or approval.
steps.accept_criteria: A comment notifying the reviewer is posted on the document.

steps.title: Finalize Accepted Edits
steps.description: Process the reviewer's feedback. Apply all approved modifications to the original document content, reject those that were not approved, and resolve the notification comment thread.
steps.accept_criteria: Approved modifications are incorporated into the document, rejected changes are omitted, and suggestion artifacts are cleaned up.

steps.title: Generate Summary Document
steps.description:
Create a new document containing the final legal review summary. The summary document must adhere to the following structure:

## Review Scope
## Key Findings
## Structural/Risk Concerns
## Redline Summary
steps.accept_criteria: A separate summary document has been created with the required structural headers (Review Scope, Key Findings, Structural/Risk Concerns, Redline Summary) filled out.

steps.title: Verify Execution
steps.description: Verify that the final approved edits have been integrated, suggestion artifacts are removed, and a structured summary document with the required sections exists.
steps.accept_criteria: Verification passed: The document is updated, temporary suggestion tabs/elements are gone, and the structured summary document exists.
